SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
SELECT
  av.id               AS av_id,
  av.risk_score,
  av.criticality_tier,
  av.sla_deadline,
  av.kev_listed,
  av.shodan_exposed,
  c.cve_id            AS cve_id_str,
  c.description       AS cve_description,
  c.cvss_v3_base_score,
  c.cvss_v3_severity,
  c.published_date,
  si.asset_name,
  si.owner_team,
  si.criticality      AS asset_criticality
FROM vulnerability_management.applicable_vulnerabilities av
JOIN vulnerability_management.cves c             ON c.id  = av.cve_id
JOIN vulnerability_management.software_inventory si ON si.id = av.software_id
WHERE av.criticality_tier IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM vulnerability_management.vulnerability_alerts va
    WHERE va.applicable_vulnerability_id = av.id
  )
ORDER BY av.risk_score DESC NULLS LAST

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
INSERT INTO vulnerability_management.vulnerability_alerts
  (applicable_vulnerability_id, alert_type, recipient, subject, message_body, sent_at)
VALUES ({{ $json.av_id }}, 'EMAIL', '{{ $json.recipient_email }}', '{{ $json.subject }}', $EMLBODY${{ $json.emailHtml }}$EMLBODY$, NOW())

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
INSERT INTO vulnerability_management.vulnerability_alerts
  (applicable_vulnerability_id, alert_type, recipient, subject, message_body, sent_at)
VALUES ({{ $json.av_id }}, 'SLACK', 'slack-webhook', '{{ $json.subject }}', $EMLBODY${{ $json.slackPayload }}$EMLBODY$, NOW())

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
INSERT INTO vulnerability_management.audit_log
  (workflow_name, execution_id, status, records_processed, executed_at)
VALUES ('workflow-alerts', '{{ $execution.id }}', 'SUCCESS', {{ $json.recordsProcessed }}, NOW())

parameters.content:
## workflow-alerts

**Trigger:** POST webhook — llamado por workflow-prioritization al terminar, o manualmente.
**Lee:** `applicable_vulnerabilities` sin alertas previas (NOT EXISTS en `vulnerability_alerts`)
**Escribe:** `vulnerability_alerts` (EMAIL + SLACK por cada AV), `audit_log`

### Fan-out desde Code Build Template
```
Code Build Template ──► Send Email ──► Insert EMAIL alert
                    └──► HTTP Slack ──► Insert SLACK alert
```
Ambas ramas reciben los mismos N items. `continueOnFail: true` en Send Email y HTTP Slack evita que un fallo de SMTP o Slack bloquee el otro canal.

### Templates
**Email HTML** — color-coded por criticality_tier:
- CRITICAL = `#ff0000` | HIGH = `#ff8800` | MEDIUM = `#ffdd00` | LOW = `#0088ff`
- Tabla con CVE ID, risk score, asset, team, CVSS, descripción, SLA
- Botón "View on NVD" vinculado a `nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/{cveID}`

**Slack Block Kit** — header + section fields + description + actions button + context footer

### Datos en Insert Slack Alert
Después de HTTP Slack el JSON del item se reemplaza con la respuesta de Slack.
Por eso Postgres Insert Slack Alert usa `$('Code Build Template').item.json` para obtener los datos originales.

### Prerequisitos
- Credencial SMTP en n8n: **VulnPatchNotifier SMTP** (id: 2)
- `SECURITY_TEAM_EMAIL` y `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` deben estar en el entorno de n8n.
